recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken (Freezer Marinade)

items.i: chopped green onion or parsley, pepper

steps: Put the chicken in a gallon freezer bag and add all the marinade ingredients.
Squeeze out the air, seal, massage to coat, label and freeze flat (up to about 3 months).
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20–25 minutes, grill, or cook in a skillet until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C). Serve with your favorite sides.
recipes.notes: Estimated. The creator only sends the marinade recipes by DM ("comment CHICKEN"), so ingredients and amounts are reconstructed from what goes into each bag in the video. Macros are rough estimates per serving and assume most of the marinade cooks onto the chicken.
